description: This file defines the public API for sys_sem (system semaphore) in Zephyr OS, including structure definitions, macros for initialization, and function prototypes for semaphore operations.

methods.name: sys_sem_init
methods.description: Initializes a semaphore with specified initial count and limit.

methods.name: sys_sem_give
methods.description: Gives (releases) the semaphore, increasing its count if not at maximum.

methods.name: sys_sem_take
methods.description: Attempts to take (acquire) the semaphore, with optional timeout.

methods.name: sys_sem_count_get
methods.description: Returns the current count of the semaphore.
